sources.content: function total(values) { if (values === undefined || values === null) return 0; for (const val of values) { if (typeof val !== 'number' || !isFinite(val)) { throw new Error('Non-numeric or non-finite value'); } } let sum = 0; for (const val of values) { sum += val; } return sum; }
